i: tip
Use Frostfire Bolt instead of Frostbolt. When Frostfire Empowerment procs, your next Frostfire Bolt is instant and explodes around the target (stacks to 2 with Severe Temperatures)
tip

Using Ray of Frost turns the button into Comet Storm. With Isothermic Core, Comet Storm also drops Meteors, so aim it at add packs; on multiple targets, spend Frostfire Empowerment first to build more Freezing, then detonate with Comet Storm (Wowhead)
tip
Glacial Spike fires a Pyroblast along with it via Duality, and Flash Freezeburn spreads 25% to 5 nearby enemies
tip
In Wowhead's build table, the M+ ★ is on Frostfire only. Icy Veins also presents Frostfire first, since its AoE burst is slightly stronger
tip
Splintering Sorcery: Frostbolt and Flurry create Frost Splinters, and Controlled Instincts deals 60% to nearby enemies
tip
Spellfrost Teachings cuts Frozen Orb's cooldown by 0.3s per splinter hit, so you use Frozen Orb more often (the Spellslinger strength Icy Veins highlights)
tip
Hand of Frost (Spellslinger build) gives Ray of Frost 2 charges, so you can hold one for a vulnerability window
tip
The Spellslinger M+ build has no Wowhead ★; the ★ are on raid single-target, raid AoE and Delve
tip

Ray of Frost · 1m · 4s channel, 8 stacks of Freezing. Your main DPS cooldown, so line it up with boss vulnerability windows and add packs. Finish the channel; if it's dangerous, don't cancel it, dodge with Shimmer (Wowhead)
tip
Frozen Orb · 1m · Damages all enemies it passes for 15s, grants Brain Freeze via Wintertide. Don't throw it before enemies are grouped (Icy Veins)
tip
Comet Storm (Frostfire build) · The button that replaces Ray of Frost after you use it. 7 comets on the target and around it
tip
Time Warp · 5m · Party haste +30% for 40s. Use it before Ray of Frost or when the party needs it (Wowhead)
tb
Ice Barrier · 30s, 2 charges (Improved Ice Barrier) · Absorbs 35% of health for 1m, 10% less physical damage taken. Have it up before combat and reapply when it breaks
tb

Ice Block · 2m 30s, 2 charges (Winter's Protection, Glacial Bulwark, Permafrost Bauble) · With Ice Cold, instead of immunity you take 70% less damage for 6s and can move and cast. With Ice Barrier also on 2 charges, you can assign them across each big damage window (Wowhead)
tb
Mirror Image · 2m · 3 images for 15s, reduced threat. Press it right before big AoE damage
tb
Alter Time · 55s (Master of Time) · After 10s or on a second press, returns you to your original position and health. Returning resets Shimmer's cooldown via Time Walk
tb
Greater Invisibility · 1m (Master of Escape) · 20s invisibility, drops threat. Use it to avoid targeted and channeled abilities (Icy Veins)
int
Counterspell · 20s (Quick Witted) · 40-meter interrupt, locks the school for 7s (1s more with Improved Counterspell). Use a focus-interrupt macro (Icy Veins)
cc
Dragon's Breath · 45s (5s less with Time Manipulation) · Disorients enemies in a 12-meter frontal cone for 4s. Used to interrupt casts in every dungeon (Wowhead, Icy Veins). Bosses are immune
cc

Polymorph · Incapacitates one add for 1m (last resort, Icy Veins). Can interrupt the Protective Turtle's Shell Guard and the Temple Disruptor's cast (Wowhead). Frost Nova · 30s (5s less with Time Manipulation) · Freezes enemies within 12 meters for 6s. Bosses are immune
disp

Remove Curse · 8s · Removes all curses from an ally. Use it on Insatiable Hunger (Starvation Effigy) in Den of Nalorakk, Curse of Doom (Corrupted Warlock) in Murder Row, and Hex (Phantom Hex Priest) in King's Rest (Wowhead)
tip

Spellsteal · Removes a beneficial magic effect from an enemy. Spiny Shield (Spineshield Beetle) in Blinding Vale, Accumulate Charge (Agitated Nimbus) in Temple, Captain's Bulwark (Guard Captain Atu) and Bound by Shadow in King's Rest, Blaze of Glory (Ashseer Flamelasher) and Stormcloud Barrier (Primal Thundercloud) in Ruby Life Pools (Wowhead)
tip
Energized Barriers · Clear Paralyzing Shots (Twinfang Harrower) in Altar of Fangs and Slither Strike (Shrouded Fang) in Temple by applying Ice Barrier (Wowhead)
tip
Greater Invisibility · Use it for skips, dropping combat, and cancelling casts and channels aimed at you. Rated as needed in every dungeon (Wowhead)
pos

Mobility: Shimmer · 27s (Flow of Time), 2 charges (Spatial Manipulation) · 20-meter teleport, even while casting. Applying Ice Barrier clears all snares via Energized Barriers. Also useful in the Murder Row broom-sweeping minigame (Wowhead)
tip
Frost spells slow the enemies they hit. This can hurt when the tank needs to drag mobs, so be careful (Icy Veins)
cc
Ascendant week: stop as many casts from the spawning adds as you can with Counterspell, Spellsteal and Dragon's Breath (Wowhead, Icy Veins)
disp
Devour week: clear the debuff from yourself or an ally with Remove Curse. The talent swap table recommends Remove Curse and Energized Barriers (Wowhead)
pos
Pulsar week: swing the orbs circling you into other party members, and take theirs too (Wowhead). Aim so you don't Shimmer past the person coming to take your orb (Icy Veins)
tip
Voidbound week: kill the Voidbound Emissary as fast as possible when it spawns, cleaving it with Splitting Ice if you can (Wowhead). +12 and above, Xal'atath's Guile: each death removes 15 seconds

macros: Interrupt your focus target if you have one, otherwise your current target. Ctrl sets your current target as focus, Shift/Alt sets your mouseover as focus (Icy Veins)
Remove curses from your mouseover ally, otherwise yourself
Steal a beneficial magic effect from your mouseover enemy, otherwise your current target
Focus target, otherwise mouseover enemy, otherwise current target

frostfire.title: Frostfire Key Points
items: Drop {Comet Storm} after {Ray of Frost} when adds are grouped, so the {Isothermic Core} Meteor hits them too
Throw {Frozen Orb} after the tank gathers adds, and when {Frostfire Empowerment} procs, detonate with an instant {Frostfire Bolt}

spellslinger.title: Spellslinger Key Points
items: Use {Frozen Orb} and {Ray of Frost} on cooldown to create splinters, and line up the Frozen Orb brought back by {Spellfrost Teachings} with big pulls
Hold one of the 2 {Ray of Frost} charges from {Hand of Frost} for a boss vulnerability window

Rav'i: [광역 피해] Every time the Ssscavenging shield goes up, focus Ray of Frost and Frozen Orb on the boss to break it quickly (Topicx: damage cooldowns go on every shield)
[광역 피해] Reapply Ice Barrier before Ravenous Stomp (145474 Nature to everyone) to absorb it (Topicx: defensives go on Stomp)
[회피] If Regurgitate slows you, reapply Ice Barrier to clear the slow with Energized Barriers
The Writhing Coil: [차단] Put Counterspell (20 sec) into one slot of the three-kick Toxic Atrophy rotation

[광역 피해] Time Frozen Orb and Blizzard for the Uncoil phase when the five Writhes appear. If Bloodlust was saved for the second boss and you are the group's lust, press Time Warp here and use Ray of Frost with it (Topicx)
[제어] Hold any Writhe moving toward the Spiteful Hunt target with Dragon's Breath or Frost Nova
Zul'jan: [회피] If Zul'jan casts Boneslicer on you, you can cancel it with Greater Invisibility (Wowhead). Do not use it when it is your turn to clear Ritual Venom

[광역 피해] Reapply Ice Barrier before the 8 sec Ritual of the Fang channel in which you body-block a beam (38793 Nature every sec), and press Ice Block (Ice Cold) if Fang Empowered stacks bring you low. Ice Cold lets you move, so you keep your beam spot (Topicx: defensives go on the beam soak channel)

Lightblossom Trinity: [차단] Kezkitt's Light Bolt does not need a kick rotation. Kick it with Counterspell (20 sec) when it is available (Topicx)

[위치] While you stand in Fertile Loam to block Lightblossom Beam, you take the Loam's Nature damage (77586 every sec) and the beam's Holy damage (77586 every 2 sec) together, so put up Ice Barrier before stepping in. When the beam ends and you leave the Loam, cast your remaining Ice Barrier charge to clear the 50% slow with Energized Barriers
Ikuzz the Light Hunter: [위치] If an ally is held by Bloodthorn Roots, aim Frozen Orb and Blizzard there to break the roots as well
[광역 피해] Keep Ice Barrier up for Thorncaller Roar (6 sec of party-wide Nature damage), and press Ice Block (Ice Cold) when it overlaps with Lightcrazed Frenzy (29095 Holy every 2 sec) after 50%

[참고] Bloodlust goes out below 50% when no Bloodthirsty Gaze chase is active (Topicx). If you are the group's lust, press Time Warp then and use Ray of Frost with it. If you are the Gaze target, gain distance with Shimmer
Lightwarden Ruia: [차단] Put Counterspell into the kick rotation for Warden's Wrath in Moonkin Form

[위치] If marked by Pulverizing Strikes, stand still, aim the cone away from the group, and reapply Ice Barrier before the first hit. Improved Ice Barrier adds 10% physical damage reduction. If Grievous Thrash is still bleeding you, press Ice Block (Ice Cold, 70% damage reduction for 6 sec)
[광역 피해] Save the second Ice Block charge and Alter Time for Spirits of the Vale after 40%
Ziekket: [차단] Kick the Lashers' Lightspore Shot (2.5 sec cast) with Counterspell before they revive. Revived Lashers are immune to interrupts and crowd control, so do not use Dragon's Breath on them
[우선 처치] Lay Frozen Orb and Blizzard on the Lashers only after the tank has taken threat in the middle of them. If you throw them earlier, the Frost slow makes the Lashers reach the tank later
[위치] Shimmer to Lightbloom's Essence orbs and step on them before they reach the boss. Absorb the stacking Holy DoT from Lightbloom's Might with Ice Barrier

The Hoardmonger: [광역 피해] Reapply Ice Barrier before the Ravenous Bellow physical damage for the absorb and 10% physical damage reduction
[위치] If the Spoiled Supplies mushroom is far, Shimmer to it within 12s; if the Bonespike Slam spike pools slow you, clear it with Ice Barrier
Sentinel of Winter: [차단] Put Counterspell into the kick rotation for Fractured Shivercore's Winter's Shroud

[우선 처치] As a ranged player, take the add away from the boss. Frozen Orb and Blizzard hit both adds and easily break the health balance, so use Glacial Spike and Ray of Frost on your add and use AoE spells only while both adds are at even health (Topicx: kill both adds at the same time)
[위치] Shimmer into the Snowdrift before Frozen Tempest
Nalorakk: [광역 피해] During Fury of the War God, use Ice Barrier for the Echoing Fury Nature damage you take while blocking Echoes, and Ice Block (Ice Cold) when low. Ice Cold lets you move, so you hold your blocking spot
[위치] If targeted by Echoing Maul, reapply Ice Barrier and Shimmer to this set's assigned corner within 4 sec (Topicx: the target uses a defensive, and each set of Echoes goes to a different corner)

Kystia Manaheart: [우선 처치] Line up Ray of Frost and Frozen Orb with the 20 sec Destabilized window on Kystia. Taking her to around 40% in the first window ends the fight in two windows (Topicx)
[차단] Kick one Mirror Images clone with Counterspell and slow the stacked clones with Dragon's Breath
Zaen Bladesorrow: [광역 피해] The second Bloodlust goes out when the boss appears (Topicx). If you are the group's lust, press Time Warp and use Ray of Frost with it
[제어] If a Warehouse Worker you brought in runs off at low health, hold it with Frost Nova (6 sec freeze) or Cone of Cold (50% slow for 8 sec)

[광역 피해] Reapply Ice Barrier before Killing Spree (armor-ignoring Physical) for the 10% Physical damage reduction, and if you cannot get behind a barrel for Murder in a Row, cut the damage by 70% with Ice Block (Ice Cold)
Xathuux the Annihilator: [우선 처치] Line up Ray of Frost with Demonic Rage, when the boss takes 30% more damage. The third Bloodlust goes on the second Demonic Rage (Topicx), so if you are the group's lust, press Time Warp then
[광역 피해] Reapply Ice Barrier before the Infernal Crush Fire damage
Lithiel Cinderfury: [차단] Put Counterspell into the Chaos Bolt kick rotation
[위치] After Malefic Wave passes, Shimmer quickly to the Demonic Gateway
[광역 피해] When the Furious Vilefiend and Wild Imps appear, put Ray of Frost on the Vilefiend and Frozen Orb and Blizzard on the stacked Wild Imps (Topicx: damage cooldowns go on add spawns)

Taz'Rah: [광역 피해] Reapply Ice Barrier before the Dark Bloom shadow damage
[회피] When Void Fissure orbs fly at you, Shimmer out of the way
Atroxus: [우선 처치] When a Toxic Creeper appears, switch to it at once with Ice Lance and Flurry. Bloodlust goes out on the first Creeper (Topicx), so if you are the group's lust, press Time Warp then and put Ray of Frost on the Creeper
[광역 피해] Reapply Ice Barrier before Monstrous Roar (armor-ignoring Physical) for the absorb and 10% Physical damage reduction, and press Ice Block (Ice Cold) if Toxic Aura overlaps and you are low
Charonus: [회피] If Charonus casts Void Cascade on you, you can cancel it with Greater Invisibility (Wowhead)

[위치] If targeted by Gravitic Orbs, drag the orb to the far Unstable Singularity that ranged players use. Close the distance with Shimmer if it is far, and clear the Condensed Mass slow with Ice Barrier (Topicx: melee use the near two, ranged the far one)

The Golden Serpent: [우선 처치] When Lucre's Call spawns Animated Gold, AoE it down with Frozen Orb and Blizzard. Frost spell slows delay them reaching the boss
[광역 피해] Reapply Ice Barrier before Serpentine Gust
[회피] Serpentine Gust can be avoided by breaking line of sight (Wowhead)
Mchimba the Embalmer: [차단] Kick the mummies' Wretched Discharge with Counterspell, and if two cast at once, stop the other cast with Dragon's Breath from within 12 yd
[광역 피해] Bloodlust goes out on Mchimba (Topicx). If you are the group's lust, press Time Warp and use Ray of Frost and Frozen Orb with it
[회피] If Mchimba casts Drain Fluids on you, you can cancel it with Greater Invisibility (Wowhead)
The Council of Tribes: [우선 처치] Kula must die before the fourth Whirling Axes (Topicx). Throw Frozen Orb on the trash dragged in and put Ray of Frost on Kula (Frostfire build follows with Comet Storm)
[차단] Put Counterspell in the kick rotation for Zanazal's Poison Nova
[참고] If targeted by Kula's Severing Axe, reduce the damage with Ice Block (Ice Cold) and keep Ice Barrier's 10% Physical damage reduction up
Dazar, The First King: [우선 처치] Bloodlust goes out at the start of Dazar (Topicx). If you are the group's lust, press Time Warp and kill Reban with Ray of Frost and Glacial Spike before 80%. Kick Reban's Deathly Roar with Counterspell
[광역 피해] Reapply Ice Barrier for the 15 sec party DoT of Gilded Destruction, and press Ice Block (Ice Cold) if you are low
[참고] On a four-lust route, Bloodlust goes out in phase 2 (after 80%) (Topicx). Put Ray of Frost on Dazar then

Melidrussa Chillworn: [차단] The tank kicks Frigid Shard personally right after the Hailburst ice lands (Topicx). Kick it with Counterspell only if the tank misses it

[우선 처치] In the 66% and 33% intermissions, break the Ice Bulwark shield with Ray of Frost and Glacial Spike (Frostfire build follows with Comet Storm). Keep Ice Barrier up for the stacking Frost Overload damage and press Ice Block (Ice Cold) if you are low
[위치] Use Shimmer when walking against the Chillstorm pull
Kokia Blazehoof: [차단] Put Counterspell in the kick rotation for Blazebound Firestorm's Blaze Volley
[우선 처치] When a Firestorm appears, switch to it at once with Ray of Frost and Glacial Spike and kill it before the next Molten Boulder (Topicx). Shimmer out when the dying Firestorm casts Burnout
[광역 피해] Refresh Ice Barrier before the Inferno Fire damage stacks up
Kyrakka & Erkhart Stormvein: [참고] Near the end of Interrupting Cloudburst, stop casting and use instants such as Ice Lance, Flurry and Frozen Orb
[우선 처치] When Kyrakka lands, kill the dragon first with Ray of Frost. After they merge, put Ray of Frost on the lower-health boss (Topicx)

[광역 피해] If targeted by Inferno Spit, Shimmer to the platform edge on the side of the next Winds of Change, and refresh Ice Barrier or press Ice Block (Ice Cold) when the circle explodes for 8 yd at the end of its 6 sec DoT (Topicx)

Adderis & Aspix: [위치] If Gale Force pushes you, Shimmer back to your Thunder and Lightning soak spot
[광역 피해] Reapply Ice Barrier before Thunder and Lightning
[회피] If Aspix casts Gust on you, you can cancel it with Greater Invisibility (Wowhead)
Merektha: [차단] Take a slot in the Toxic Viper's Poison Spit rotation with Counterspell
[우선 처치] When Hatch adds spawn, kill them together with Frozen Orb and Blizzard
Galvazzt: [위치] On your beam-soaking turn, when Galvanized raises your physical damage taken by 250%, keep Ice Barrier (10% physical damage reduction) up; if it gets dangerous, hold on with Ice Block (Ice Cold). Ice Cold lets you move, so you keep your spot
Avatar of Sethraliss: [우선 처치] Line up Ray of Frost on the Essence Defiler to kill it fast
[차단] Take a slot in the Twisted Hexxer's Flame Shock rotation with Counterspell
[제어] If a pack of Faithless Tormentors chases the healer, delay them with Dragon's Breath or freeze them with Frost Nova

116.m: 2% (기본 마나 중) · 40 야드 사정거리 · 1.75 초 주문 시전 시간
116.d: 적에게 얼음 화살을 날려 (주문력의 244.8%)의 냉기 피해를 입히고 8초 동안 이동 속도를 50%만큼 감소시킵니다.

118.m: 4% (기본 마나 중) · 30 야드 사정거리 · 1.7 초 주문 시전 시간
118.d:
1분 동안 적을 양으로 변이시켜, 행동 불가 상태가 된 채 주변을 떠돌게 만듭니다. 대상은 떠도는 동안 아무런 행동을 취하지 못하지만 매우 빠른 속도로 생명력이 회복됩니다. 대상이 피해를 입으면 효과가 취소될 수 있으며, 동시에 한 대상만 변이시킬 수 있습니다.

야수, 인간형, 동물에게만 사용할 수 있습니다. [문양: 동물변이: 동물에게 사용하는 경우 여러 동물에게 사용할 수 있고 지속시간이 1일이 됩니다]

120.m: 4% (기본 마나 중) · 즉시 · 25 초 재사용 대기시간
120.d: 전방 부채꼴 범위의 대상에게 (주문력의 43.125%)의 냉기 피해를 입히고, 8초 동안 이동 속도를 50%만큼 감소시킵니다.

122.m: 2% (기본 마나 중) · 즉시 · 30 초 재사용 대기시간 · 1회 사용 가능
122.d: 자신으로부터 12미터 내의 적을 강타하여 (주문력의 5.149%)의 냉기 피해를 입히고 6초 동안 그 자리에 얼어붙게 만듭니다. 대상이 피해를 입으면 효과가 해제될 수 있습니다.

475.m: 특성 · 1.3% (기본 마나 중) · 40 야드 사정거리 · 즉시 · 8 초 재사용 대기시간

1459.d:

파티원이나 공격대원에게 시전하면 모든 파티원과 공격대원이 효과를 받습니다.

2139.m: 2% (기본 마나 중) · 40 야드 사정거리 · 즉시 · 25 초 재사용 대기시간
2139.d: 적의 주문 시전을 차단하여, 7초 동안 같은 계열의 주문을 시전하지 못하게 만듭니다.

11426.m: 특성 · 3% (기본 마나 중) · 즉시 · 30 초 재사용 대기시간 · 1회 사용 가능
11426.d:
1분 동안 자신에게 얼음 보호막을 씌워 [35 / 100 * 총 생명력 * (1 + 유연성)]의 피해를 흡수 [빙하의 단절: 하고 방어도를 0%만큼 증가시킵니다 / 합니다].

근접 공격을 받으면 공격자의 이동 속도를 50%만큼 감소시킵니다.

30449.m: 특성 · 21% (기본 마나 중) · 40 야드 사정거리 · 즉시
30449.d: 대상으로부터 이로운 마법 효과 하나를 훔칩니다. 이 효과는 최대 2분 동안 지속됩니다.

30455.m: 특성 · 1% (기본 마나 중) · 40 야드 사정거리 · 즉시
30455.d:
빠르게 대상에게 얼음 조각을 날려 (주문력의 183.75%)의 냉기 피해를 입힙니다.

빙결 4중첩을 산산조각 냅니다.

31661.m: 특성 · 4% (기본 마나 중) · 즉시 · 45 초 재사용 대기시간
31661.d: 전방 부채꼴 12미터 범위 내의 적에게 (주문력의 66.99%)의 화염 피해를 입히고 4초 동안 방향 감각을 상실하게 만듭니다. 피해를 입으면 효과가 사라집니다.

44614.m: 특성 · 1% (기본 마나 중) · 40 야드 사정거리 · 즉시 · 30 초 재사용 대기시간 · 2회 사용 가능
44614.d:
휘몰아치는 얼음을 방출해 대상을 3 / 혹한의 바람: 7 / 진눈깨비 연마: 4번 공격하여 총 [(주문력의 128.52%) * 3 / 혹한의 바람: - 7 / 진눈깨비 연마: 4]의 냉기 피해를 입힙니다.

빙결 (3 / 혹한의 바람: - 7 / 진눈깨비 연마: 4)중첩을 부여합니다.

45438.m: 특성 · 즉시 · 4 분 재사용 대기시간 · 1회 사용 가능
45438.d:
커다란 얼음 덩어리에 둘러싸여 10초 동안 모든 공격과 피해로부터 보호받습니다. 하지만 이 동안은 공격하거나 이동하거나 마법을 사용하지 못합니다.

저체온증을 유발하여, 30초 동안은 얼음 방패를 다시 시전하지 못합니다.

55342.m: 특성 · 2% (기본 마나 중) · 즉시 · 2 분 재사용 대기시간
55342.d:
15초 동안 자신의 복제 3개를 주위에 생성합니다. 이 복제는 주문을 시전하고 적을 공격합니다. 활성화된 동안 생성하는 위협 수준이 크게 감소합니다.

직접 피해를 받으면 환영 하나가 사라집니다. (2초 재사용 대기시간)

56377.d: 진눈깨비와 [얼음불꽃 화살 / 얼음 화살] 주문이 50%의 효율로 1명의 추가 대상을 공격합니다.

80353.m: 4% (기본 마나 중) · 즉시 · 5 분 재사용 대기시간
80353.d:
시간의 흐름을 왜곡하여, 40초 동안 모든 파티원과 공격대원의 가속을 30%만큼 증가시킵니다.

아군은 10분 동안 피의 욕망, 영웅심, 시간 왜곡 효과를 받지 못합니다.

84714.m: 특성 · 1% (기본 마나 중) · 40 야드 사정거리 · 즉시 · 1 분 재사용 대기시간
84714.d:
전방으로 소용돌이치는 얼음 구슬을 내보내 15초에 걸쳐 경로상에 있는 모든 적에게 최대 [20 * (주문력의 77.7%)]의 냉기 피해를 입힙니다. 잠시 후에 얼어붙은 구슬은 대상을 추적합니다. 8명을 초과하는 대상에게는 감소된 피해를 입힙니다.

얼어붙은 구슬에 피해를 입은 적은 8초 동안 이동 속도가 50%만큼 감소합니다.

110959.d: 즉시 투명 상태로 변해 20초 동안 적의 대상이 되지 않고 위협 수준을 모두 제거합니다. 어떤 행동이든 취하면 효과가 취소됩니다.

112965.d:
[얼음불꽃 화살 / 얼음 화살] 시전 시 15%의 확률로 서리의 손가락 충전이 부여됩니다.

서리의 손가락은 다음 얼음창 시전 시 빙결 4중첩과 같은 산산조각 피해를 입히게 하는 한편, 빙결 중첩을 소모하지는 않습니다.

최대 2번 충전됩니다.

190336.d: 마법사와 아군이 먹을 수 있는 마나 음식을 창조합니다. 창조된 음식은 접속 종료 후 15분이 지나면 사라집니다.

190356.m: 특성 · 2.5% (기본 마나 중) · 40 야드 사정거리 · 2 초 주문 시전 시간 · 12 초 재사용 대기시간
190356.d:

이 주문은 지정된 위치에 시전됩니다.

190447.d: [얼음불꽃 화살 / 얼음 화살] 시전 시 25 / 얼어붙은 손길: 30 / 서리불꽃 주입: 26 / 대마법사의 분노: 30%의 확률로 진눈깨비의 남은 재사용 대기시간이 초기화되고, 다음 진눈깨비의 공격력이 50%만큼 증가합니다.

199786.m: 5% (기본 마나 중) · 40 야드 사정거리 · 1.75 초 주문 시전 시간
199786.d:
거대한 쐐기를 만든 뒤 대상을 꿰뚫어 (주문력의 1300%)의 피해를 입히고 8초 동안 대상의 이동 속도를 50%만큼 감소시킵니다.

빙결 3중첩을 부여합니다.

205021.m: 특성 · 2% (기본 마나 중) · 40 야드 사정거리 · 집중 (4 초 주문 시전 시간) · 1 분 재사용 대기시간 · 1회 사용 가능
205021.d:
4초 동안 적에게 얼음 광선을 집중해 0.50초마다 (주문력의 450%)의 냉기 피해를 입힙니다.

지속시간에 걸쳐 빙결 8중첩을 부여합니다.

205030.d: 얼음 화살 시전 시 서리의 손가락이 25%만큼, 두뇌 빙결이 20%만큼 더 자주 발동합니다.

212653.m: 특성 · 점멸을(를) 대신함 · 2% (기본 마나 중) · 즉시 · 30 초 재사용 대기시간 · 1회 사용 가능

378448.d: 얼음창이 50%의 효율로 1명의 추가 대상을 공격합니다. 빙결 중첩이 높은 적을 우선적으로 공격합니다.

378919.d: [얼음불꽃 화살 / 얼음 화살] 및 진눈깨비의 치명타 및 극대화 피해가 20%만큼 증가합니다.

414659.d: 얼음 방패 시전 시 6초 동안 받는 모든 피해가 70%만큼 감소하지만 더는 면역 상태가 되지도, 이동, 공격, 주문 시전을 방지하지도 않습니다. 전역 재사용 대기시간을 발동시키지 않습니다.

417489.d:

1280780.d: 혹한의 쐐기가 빙결을 부여하지 않으며, 빙결 5중첩을 산산조각 냅니다.

1: [차단] Put Counterspell (20 sec with Quick Witted) into the kick rotation for Radiant Spellsower's Light Bolt Volley (4 sec cast, 174568 Holy).

[제어] When a Spellsower gets low, hold it with Cone of Cold (25 sec, 50% slow for 8 sec) or Frost Nova (25 sec with Time Manipulation, 6 sec freeze) so it cannot run off with Call The Grove. If it has already started channeling Frantic Blooming, stop it with Dragon's Breath (40 sec with Time Manipulation).

[광역 피해] This is the pull where everything is stacked and Bloodlust goes out. If you are the group's lust, press Time Warp (5 min) here and use Frozen Orb (1 min) together with Ray of Frost (1 min) (Frostfire build follows with Comet Storm). Take Sporeblight Belcher's Spouting Floret (87284 Holy every 2 sec for 6 sec) with Ice Barrier (absorbs 35% of health).
2: [차단] When both Radiant Spellsowers cast Light Bolt Volley, kick one with Counterspell, then step within 12 yards of the two stacked at the tank and stop both with Dragon's Breath (4 sec disorient).
[광역 피해] Use Ice Barrier for Spouting Floret. Improved Ice Barrier gives it 2 charges, so one is still left after pull 1.
3: [제어] Two Radiant Spellsowers sit next to 12 Lashers, so hold any Spellsower running to the dormant Lasher pack with Frost Nova or Cone of Cold to prevent Frantic Blooming.

[우선 처치] A Lightgorged Lasher with its Lightbloom Pollination shield (absorbs 600108) is immune to crowd control, so do not waste Dragon's Breath on it. Focus Glacial Spike and Ice Lance on that Lasher to break the shield first.
[광역 피해] Once the 12 Lashers are stacked at the tank, the Frozen Orb (1 min) from pull 1 is back, so throw it into the middle of the pack and add Blizzard.
5: [차단] Kick Lightfeather Petalwing's Disorienting Screech (4 sec cast) with Counterspell. If it goes off, the whole group is disoriented for 3 sec.

[광역 피해] Sporeblight Belcher is pulled first and Virid Grovekeeper joins 5-6 sec later, so throw Frozen Orb only after the Grovekeeper is stacked too. Take the earlier Spouting Floret with Ice Barrier.

[제어] Neither Frost Mythic+ build has a stun. Leave stunning Thorny Saptor's Thornclaw Leap (193965 Physical frontal plus knockback every 2 sec for 6 sec) to a party member who has one, and if a Saptor leaps at you, Shimmer (27 sec, 2 charges) out of the cone.
7: [참고] Remove the Spiny Shield (absorbs 500090, reflects 4849 Nature to attackers) on the 5 Spineshield Beetles with Spellsteal (Wowhead: Spellsteal is needed in this dungeon). It removes one shield per cast, so cycle Spellsteal before laying down Frozen Orb and Blizzard, and absorb the reflected damage with Ice Barrier.
[차단] Kick Lightfeather Petalwing's Disorienting Screech with Counterspell, and kick Leafy Grovecrawler's Seed Shot too when you have it spare.

[광역 피해] The two Luminous Thornmaws have a lot of health and live long, so time Ray of Frost for this pull (Spellslinger build has 2 charges via Hand of Frost). If you are inside Solar Breath (3 sec cast, 387930 Holy), do not cancel the channel; Shimmer out instead.
8: [참고] Spellsteal the Spineshield Beetles' Spiny Shields one by one, and the Ice Barrier you put up for Spouting Floret also absorbs the Nature damage reflected by any shield left.
[차단] Leafy Grovecrawler's Seed Shot (2.5 sec cast, 116379 Nature) on the two Grovecrawlers is an optional kick, so stop it with Counterspell when it is available.
[제어] If a Thorny Saptor's Thornclaw Leap targets you, Shimmer out of the cone and leave the stun to a party member who has one.
10: [해제] Frost cannot remove Potatoad Matriarch's Toxic Spew (67888 Nature plus a 9 sec poison DoT), so leave it to a party member who can, and when you see the cast, reapply Ice Barrier to absorb the hit and the poison DoT.

[우선 처치] Break Potadpole Eggs right away with instant Ice Lance. When the two Lightgorged Lashers activate Lightbloom Pollination shields, nearby mobs gain 50% attack speed, so fire Glacial Spike at that Lasher to break the shield.
[광역 피해] Time Ray of Frost (1 min) for the high-health Matriarch (Frostfire build follows with Comet Storm), and throw Frozen Orb toward the side where the 7 Lashers are stacked.
11: [차단] When all three Lightfeather Petalwings cast Disorienting Screech, kick one with Counterspell and stop the other two with Dragon's Breath once they are stacked at the tank.

[광역 피해] Use Ice Barrier for Spouting Floret, and if both charges are spent, press Ice Block (Ice Cold: 70% damage reduction for 6 sec while still moving and casting). Shimmer out of Luminous Thornmaw's Solar Breath cone.
12: [우선 처치] Six Lightgorged Lashers will activate Lightbloom Pollination shields, so stack Frozen Orb and Ray of Frost (plus Comet Storm in the Frostfire build) on this pull to break the shields together. Shielded Lashers are immune to crowd control, so do not use Dragon's Breath on them.
[차단] Split the two Radiant Spellsowers' Light Bolt Volley between Counterspell and Dragon's Breath, and hold any Spellsower that tries to run with Frost Nova or Cone of Cold.
[광역 피해] Use Ice Barrier for Sporeblight Belcher's Spouting Floret.

1: [차단] Take one of the two Primal Serpents' Piercing Hiss (4 sec cast, 135775 armor-ignoring Physical) with Counterspell (20 sec with Quick Witted).

[해제] When Twinfang Harrower's Paralyzing Shots hits you (48491 Nature every sec for 20 sec, each tick slows you by 10%), reapply Ice Barrier (30 sec, 2 charges). Energized Barriers removes the slow (Wowhead).

[제어] If the seven Ravenous Descendants stack attack speed with Ravenous Claws and the tank starts taking heavy damage, step within 12 yards of the pack, freeze it with Frost Nova (25 sec with Time Manipulation, 6 sec freeze) and let the tank gain distance. Damage can break the freeze, so lay Frozen Orb and Blizzard after the tank has repositioned.
2: [우선 처치] Focus Ray of Frost (1 min) and Glacial Spike on the Ritual Chieftain to kill it before several Blood Sacrifices land (Frostfire build follows with Comet Storm). Kick Primal Serpent's Piercing Hiss with Counterspell.

[광역 피해] Blood Sacrifice (87284 Physical to the whole group plus a 162029 heal absorb) can be avoided by breaking line of sight (Wowhead). If you cannot break line of sight, have Ice Barrier up before it lands. Improved Ice Barrier also reduces the Physical damage you take by 10%.
3: [차단] When the three Primal Serpents walk down behind the pillar, take one Piercing Hiss with Counterspell. If kicks run short, step within 12 yards of the Serpents stacked at the tank and stop the remaining casts with Dragon's Breath (40 sec with Time Manipulation, 4 sec disorient).
[광역 피해] If you could not line of sight Blood Sacrifice and both Ice Barrier charges are spent, press Ice Block (Ice Cold: 70% damage reduction for 6 sec while still moving and casting).
4: [위치] Do not use Frozen Orb or Blizzard until the two central Ravenous Descendants have moved away from the Twinfang Harrower. Frozen Orb hits every enemy it passes through and can pull the Harrower in.
[우선 처치] Put Glacial Spike and Ray of Frost on the Ritual Chieftain, and take one Primal Serpent's Piercing Hiss with Counterspell.
5: [광역 피해] This is the biggest pull at 103 trash. Throw Frozen Orb (1 min) only after everything is stacked, and put Ray of Frost on the Ritual Chieftain first (Frostfire build follows with Comet Storm). Blood Sacrifice can be avoided by breaking line of sight (Wowhead).

[해제] Clear the slow from the two Twinfang Harrowers' Paralyzing Shots by reapplying Ice Barrier for Energized Barriers (Wowhead), and press Ice Block (Ice Cold) if the DoT and Blood Sacrifice overlap while you are low.
[회피] If you are inside the Toxic Breath frontal (3 sec cast, 67888 Nature every 0.5 sec), do not stop casting; Shimmer out (27 sec with Flow of Time, 2 charges). Shimmer can be used while casting.
7: [차단] Kick High Evolutionist's Mass Envenom (3.5 sec cast) with Counterspell. The cast that would land right before Rattling Writhe's Rattle must be kicked, so hold Counterspell for it.

[제어] If no kick is left for Evolve (6 sec channel), stop it with Dragon's Breath within 12 yards to deny the shield and crowd-control immunity. Neither Frost Mythic+ build has a stun, so leave stunning the Bloodletters to a party member who has one.
[광역 피해] When you see the Rattle cast (3 sec cast, then 58189 armor-ignoring Physical every sec for 5 sec), reapply Ice Barrier. It adds 10% Physical damage reduction on top of the absorb.
8: [광역 피해] Put Ray of Frost on the high-health Rattling Writhe, and reapply Ice Barrier when you see the Rattle cast. If no charge is left, take it with Ice Block (Ice Cold).
9: [차단] The High Evolutionist far to the left is pulled in by one ranged player. If that is you, kick its Mass Envenom with 40 yd Counterspell so it walks to the tank.
[우선 처치] Focus Glacial Spike and Ray of Frost on the two High Evolutionists to kill them before the second Mass Envenom.
11: [차단] Each of the four High Evolutionists gets its own kicker, so kick your assigned one's Mass Envenom with Counterspell.
[제어] When several channel Evolve together, step within 12 yards of the pack stacked at the tank and stop them all with Dragon's Breath.
12: [우선 처치] Ascendant Serpent must die before the third Infest, so line up Ray of Frost on this mini-boss (Spellslinger build has 2 charges via Hand of Frost; Frostfire build follows with Comet Storm).
[광역 피해] When Infest hits you (34914 Nature every sec for 5 sec, then 69827 Nature within 8 yd), reapply Ice Barrier to absorb it, and Shimmer out if you are inside a Virulent Whirl impact circle.
13: [차단] Ula'tek's Chosen's Mass Envenom must be kicked every time, so do not spend Counterspell on other mobs and save it for the Chosen.

[우선 처치] Frozen Orb hits every enemy it passes through, so do not pour Frozen Orb and Blizzard into the pack or all six Living Venoms die at once. Focus Glacial Spike and Ray of Frost on the Chosen to kill it first.

[광역 피해] Reapply Ice Barrier for Toxic Surge (29095 Nature every sec for 9 sec), and Shimmer out of Toxic Beam lines (339438 Nature). Frost has no stun, so leave stunning the Blades of the Altar to a party member who has one.
14: [차단] Kick Ula'tek's Chosen's Mass Envenom with Counterspell every time.
[광역 피해] Killing the Chosen back to back means Toxic Surge comes again, so follow Ice Barrier with Ice Block (Ice Cold, 2.5 min, 2 charges) on this pull.
15: [차단] Take one of the two Primal Serpents' Piercing Hiss with Counterspell.
[해제] Clear Twinfang Harrower's Paralyzing Shots slow by reapplying Ice Barrier for Energized Barriers (Wowhead). Shimmer out of the Toxic Breath frontal.
16: [우선 처치] Put Ray of Frost on Ula'tek's Chosen (Frostfire build follows with Comet Storm) to kill it before the second Toxic Surge, and kick its Mass Envenom with Counterspell.

[광역 피해] The two Ritual Chieftains' Blood Sacrifices can be avoided by breaking line of sight (Wowhead). If you cannot, take the first with Ice Barrier and the second with the remaining charge, and press Ice Block (Ice Cold) if Toxic Surge overlaps too.
[광역 피해] Cast Alter Time (55 sec with Master of Time) right before Blood Sacrifice, then press it again after the hit to return to your earlier health.

1: [광역 피해] This pull takes Bribed Captain and Bribed Guard together with Bloodlust. If you are the group's lust, press Time Warp (5 min) and put Ray of Frost (1 min) on the Captain, which dies first (Frostfire build follows with Comet Storm). Throw Frozen Orb once the pack is stacked at the tank.

[광역 피해] If Row Hooligan's Cutpurse (38793 Physical plus 155172 bleed over 8 sec) jumps on you, reapply Ice Barrier (30 sec, 2 charges). Improved Ice Barrier also cuts your Physical damage taken by 10%. Frost cannot remove Street Sneak's Heartstop Poison, so leave it to the poison dispeller.
2: [차단] Each of the two Seductive Sayaads gets one kicker for Seduction (3 sec cast, 6 sec disorient), so kick your assigned one with Counterspell (20 sec with Quick Witted). If its kicker misses, stop it with Dragon's Breath within 12 yards (40 sec with Time Manipulation, 4 sec disorient).
[회피] The four Felwyrms explode with Fel Detonation (193965 Fire within 4 yd) when they die, so if you were standing by the pack outside the door, Shimmer out (27 sec with Flow of Time, 2 charges).
5: [우선 처치] Focus Glacial Spike and Ray of Frost on the Massive Felwyrm to kill it first. While it lives, Over-infused hits everyone within 50 yards for 38793 Fire every 3 sec, so keep Ice Barrier up.

[회피] When the Massive Felwyrm dies it casts Massive Fel Detonation (5 sec cast, 290947 Fire within 10 yd), so Shimmer out of 10 yards. Frost cannot remove Corroding Spittle (Magic), so ask for a dispel.
8: [차단] Kick Wrathguard Flayer's Fel Rage (3.5 sec cast, 60% damage reduction and crowd-control immunity for 1 min) with Counterspell first. Frost cannot remove enrage effects. Kick Fel Invoker's Health Funnel channel with the next kick.

[우선 처치] Below 50%, Shivan Punisher enters Demonic Frenzy and pulses 29095 Fire every sec until it dies, so save Ray of Frost for the below-50% window and kill it in one go. Keep Ice Barrier up during Demonic Frenzy.
9: [해제] Remove Corrupted Warlock's Curse of Doom (581895 Shadow after 10 sec, split within 4 yd) right away with Remove Curse (8 sec) (Wowhead: Remove Curse is needed in this dungeon).
[회피] If Corrupted Warlock casts Drain Life on you, cancel the channel with Greater Invisibility (1 min with Master of Escape) (Wowhead). If it is not cancelled, the Warlock heals a lot.
[광역 피해] The eight Demon Flies are safe to pull in bulk, so lay Frozen Orb and Blizzard once they stack at the tank, and kick Wrathguard Flayer's Fel Rage with Counterspell.
10: [차단] Kick Fel Invoker's first Health Funnel (30 sec channel, heals its target for 10% max health every 2 sec) with Counterspell.
[우선 처치] When Shivan Punisher drops below 50%, put Ray of Frost on it to keep Demonic Frenzy short (Frostfire build follows with Comet Storm). Throw Frozen Orb into the eight Demon Flies.
11: [광역 피해] Use Ice Barrier for Felmaster Lucsei's Blade Dance (2 sec cast, 43642 Fire to everyone every 0.4 sec for 1.2 sec), and the remaining charge or Ice Block (Ice Cold, 70% damage reduction for 6 sec) for the next one. Alternate with the group's party defensives.
[우선 처치] Focus Ray of Frost and Glacial Spike on Lucsei so Blade Dance does not go out more than three times. Shimmer out of the Eye Beam frontal.
13: [차단] Kick the two Wrathguard Flayers' Fel Rage with Counterspell first, and stop the Unleashed Imps' Felfire Burst (1.5 sec cast) with Dragon's Breath within 12 yards once they stack at the tank.

[광역 피해] When you see Defiled Golem's Defiled Slam (2 sec cast, 145474 Fire to everyone), reapply Ice Barrier, and Shimmer away from the Defiled Detonations landing nearby (193965 Shadow within 5 yd). Put Ray of Frost on the Golem and Frozen Orb on the imp pack.
14: [차단] Kick Wrathguard Flayer's Fel Rage and Fel Invoker's Health Funnel with Counterspell, and stop the six Unleashed Imps' Felfire Burst together with Dragon's Breath.
[광역 피해] Lay Frozen Orb and Blizzard once the six imps are stacked.
15: [해제] Remove Corrupted Warlock's Curse of Doom right away with Remove Curse, and cancel Drain Life on you with Greater Invisibility (Wowhead).
[우선 처치] Focus Glacial Spike on the Corrupted Warlock the tank drags back and kills first, then put Ray of Frost on the Shivan Punisher below 50% when it is fought separately.
16: [우선 처치] Defiled Golem's AoE must end within two casts, so stack Ray of Frost and Frozen Orb (plus Comet Storm in the Frostfire build) on the Golem.

[광역 피해] Take the first Defiled Slam with Ice Barrier and the second with the remaining charge or Ice Block (Ice Cold). Do not stop casting for Fel Beam; Shimmer backward out of it. Kick Fel Invoker's Health Funnel with Counterspell.

1: [해제] Remove the Insatiable Hunger curse (max health -15%, stacking) applied by Spirit of Hunger's Starvation Effigy with Remove Curse (8 sec) (Wowhead: Remove Curse is needed in this dungeon).

[회피] You can cancel Spirit of Hunger's Feast of Misery channel (38793 Shadow every sec for 5 sec) with Greater Invisibility (1 min with Master of Escape) (Wowhead). When you save Greater Invisibility, reapply Ice Barrier to absorb it.

[광역 피해] This is the first Bloodlust pull. If you are the group's lust, press Time Warp (5 min) and use Frozen Orb and Ray of Frost with it (Frostfire build follows with Comet Storm). Break the Starvation Effigy totem first with instant Ice Lance.
2: [차단] Earthwhisper Tender's Healing Breeze (3.5 sec cast, heals nearby allies for 5% max health every 2 sec) and Earth Bolt (2.5 sec cast, 116379 Nature) both need kicks, so put Counterspell (20 sec with Quick Witted) into the kick rotation.
[해제] Remove the Insatiable Hunger curse with Remove Curse before it reaches 2 stacks.
3: [차단] Put Counterspell into the kick rotation for Earthwhisper Tender's Healing Breeze and Earth Bolt.
[해제] Remove the Insatiable Hunger curse with Remove Curse, and cancel the Feast of Misery channel with Greater Invisibility (1 min) if the one used on pull 1 is back.
4: [해제] Remove the Insatiable Hunger curse with Remove Curse.

[광역 피해] When the three Keen-Eyed Strikers' Razor Dive bleeds (33944 Physical every sec for 10 sec, stacking) build up, reapply Ice Barrier for the absorb and 10% Physical damage reduction, and press Ice Block (Ice Cold, 70% damage reduction for 6 sec) at high stacks.
5: [차단] While the group clicks the barrels, kick the Earthwhisper Tender's Healing Breeze and Earth Bolt with 40 yd Counterspell as the tank drags the pack over.
7: [광역 피해] This is the cooldown pull after the boss. If you lay Frozen Orb and Blizzard while the tank circles the outside, the Frost slow makes the mobs arrive late, so use Frozen Orb and Ray of Frost (Frostfire build follows with Comet Storm) only once everything is stacked in the corner (Icy Veins: Frost spells slow the enemies they hit).

[차단] Take one of the two Earthwhisper Tenders' Healing Breeze with Counterspell, and if both cast together, step within 12 yards and stop them with Dragon's Breath (40 sec with Time Manipulation, 4 sec disorient).
8: [우선 처치] Break Terra Rumbler's Rumbling Ward shield with Glacial Spike and Ray of Frost. While the shield is up everyone takes 24246 Nature every 2 sec, so keep Ice Barrier up.
9: [차단] Take one of the two Frigid Maulers' Frigid Roar (3.5 sec cast, -50% Haste and movement speed) with Counterspell. If it lands, your Haste is halved and the Ray of Frost channel gets longer.
[광역 피해] This is the second Bloodlust pull. If you are the group's lust, press Time Warp, and put Ray of Frost on Terra Rumbler's Rumbling Ward shield.
[위치] If Glacial Revenant's Cryo Surge (damage within 4 yd) targets you, Shimmer (27 sec with Flow of Time, 2 charges) away from the group.
10: [차단] The two Frigid Maulers' Frigid Roar has a long cast and is easy to kick. Kick one with Counterspell, and if both cast together, stop them with Dragon's Breath.
[광역 피해] This is the cooldown pull after Bloodlust. If the Frozen Orb (1 min) used on pull 9 is back, throw it once the Frostfangs are stacked at the tank.
11: [우선 처치] Focus Ray of Frost and Glacial Spike on the Avatar of Determination to kill it first, then break Terra Rumbler's Rumbling Ward shield.
[회피] When you see Pulverize (4 sec cast, 4 sec stun and 387930 Physical within 12 yd), do not stop casting; Shimmer out of 12 yards.
13: [차단] Take one of the two Stormbound Mystics' Arc Lightning (4 sec cast, 193965 Nature to up to 3 players) with Counterspell.
[우선 처치] Break Ruthless Totemcaller's Magma Totem (36368 Fire to everyone every 0.3 sec) right away with instant Ice Lance.

[광역 피해] When you see Grizzled Warbringer's Primal Echo cast (armor-ignoring Physical, stacking), reapply Ice Barrier for the 10% Physical damage reduction. The two alternate, so use the remaining charge or Ice Block (Ice Cold) on the next Echo.
14: [우선 처치] Break the two Ruthless Totemcallers' Magma Totems right away with Ice Lance, and kick Stormbound Mystic's Arc Lightning with Counterspell.
[제어] If a Loyal Saberfang fixates you with Bestial Wrath, freeze it with Frost Nova (25 sec with Time Manipulation, 6 sec freeze) and gain distance with Shimmer.
15: [광역 피해] The four Grizzled Warbringers' Primal Echoes come one after another, so spread both Ice Barrier charges, both Ice Block (Ice Cold, 2.5 min) charges and Alter Time (55 sec with Master of Time) across the Echoes, one per Echo.
[차단] Take one of the two Stormbound Mystics' Arc Lightning with Counterspell, and break Magma Totems right away with Ice Lance.
[광역 피해] This is a big 85-trash pull, so use Frozen Orb and Ray of Frost (Frostfire build follows with Comet Storm) once the four Warbringers are stacked.
16: [차단] Put Counterspell into the kick rotation for Loa Speaker Nanea's Lightning Bolt (2.5 sec cast).

[우선 처치] When the three Volatile Totems appear, lay Frozen Orb and Blizzard on the totems to finish them on the second wave. If Nanea is around 10% health, kill her first with Glacial Spike and Ray of Frost.
[광역 피해] In higher keys Bloodlust goes out here. If you are the group's lust, press Time Warp now and use Ray of Frost with it.

1: [차단] The tank takes the first kick on Voidtouched Magi's Shadowbolt Volley (4 sec cast, 193965 Shadow within 60 yd), so take the second with Counterspell (20 sec with Quick Witted). Split the two Enthralled Shamans' Lava Bolt with the other kickers.

[위치] If targeted by Null Eruption (4 sec cast, 145474 Shadow within 10 yd plus a 5 sec DoT), Shimmer (27 sec with Flow of Time, 2 charges) out of the group and reapply Ice Barrier (30 sec, 2 charges).

[광역 피해] This pull takes the whole first corridor with Bloodlust. If you are the group's lust, press Time Warp (5 min), put Ray of Frost (1 min) on the Voidtouched Magi, and throw Frozen Orb once everything is stacked in the room around the corner.
2: [우선 처치] When Raj'kess the Spellstorm summons the three Orbs of Disruption, switch to them at once with instant Ice Lance and Flurry and break them before their casts finish.

[광역 피해] Reapply Ice Barrier for the long Thundering Storm party damage, and press Ice Block (Ice Cold, 70% damage reduction for 6 sec) if you get low. Stand apart from the group for Forked Lightning (77586 Nature, bounces to 2 nearby players).
3: [제어] Protective Turtle's Shell Guard (20 sec channel, nearby allies take 75% less damage) can be interrupted with Polymorph (Wowhead). If the other mobs cannot be dragged out of range, cast Polymorph on it.

[광역 피해] Reapply Ice Barrier for Chitigoth's Insidious Aura (87284 Nature to everyone every 2 sec for 10 sec), and press Ice Block (Ice Cold) if it overlaps and you are low. Put Ray of Frost on Chitigoth, which arrives first, and when Brutok hits a wall and is stunned for 5 sec by Concussion, pour Glacial Spike into it.
[해제] If Angry Krolusk's Violent Sand hits you (155172 Nature to everyone and a 40% slow for 12 sec), reapply Ice Barrier to clear the slow with Energized Barriers.
5: [차단] Kilivore Screamer's Mad Shriek (3.5 sec cast, 6 sec fear within 60 yd) is the most important kick in this area. Do not spend Counterspell on other casts; save it for the Screamer.
[위치] If targeted by Watchful Harrower's Void Beam (43642 Shadow within 8 yd every 0.5 sec for 4 sec), Shimmer out of the group and reapply Ice Barrier.
6: [우선 처치] When Brutal Overseer raises its Brutal Slams shield, break it quickly with Ray of Frost and Glacial Spike (Frostfire build follows with Comet Storm). Kill it before the next shield so it does not overlap with Watchful Harrower's Sky Strike soak.
[광역 피해] Keep Ice Barrier up while Brutal Slams continues (48491 Physical to everyone every 1.5 sec, 10% more per slam). Improved Ice Barrier cuts your Physical damage taken by 10%.
8: [우선 처치] Switch at once with Ice Lance and Glacial Spike to the low-health mob (marked with an icon) that Devouring Brutalizer targets with Devour (9 sec cast, heals 50%), and kill it before the cast finishes.
[차단] Kick Kilivore Screamer's Mad Shriek with Counterspell first, and kick Voidminder's Mending Void (20 sec channeled heal) when Counterspell is back.

[광역 피해] This is the cooldown pull. Use Frozen Orb and Ray of Frost (Frostfire build follows with Comet Storm) once everything is stacked, reapply Ice Barrier for Dreadbellow (29095 Shadow every sec for 12 sec, cannot be dispelled), and press Ice Block (Ice Cold) if you are low.
9: [광역 피해] Lay Frozen Orb and Blizzard once the ten Scavenging Siphoids are stacked. When a Devour target is marked with an icon, switch to it at once with Ice Lance.
[차단] Kick Kilivore Screamer's Mad Shriek with Counterspell.
10: [우선 처치] Kill Devouring Brutalizer's Devour target first with Ice Lance and Glacial Spike, and put Ray of Frost on the Watchful Harrower.
[광역 피해] If the Dreadbellow Shadow DoT and Void Beam overlap, follow Ice Barrier with Ice Block (Ice Cold). If targeted by Void Beam, Shimmer out of the group.

1: [광역 피해] This is the dungeon's first pull, so Bloodlust goes out here (Topicx). If you are the group's lust, press Time Warp (5 min) once the two Animated Guardians have been dragged into the Shadow-Borne Champion pack, throw Frozen Orb (1 min) into the middle of the pack and put Ray of Frost (1 min) on the Champion (Frostfire build follows with Comet Storm).

[광역 피해] Shadow Whirlwind (4 sec cast, 164870 Shadow within 100 yd) needs a personal defensive on every cast (Topicx). Take the first with Ice Barrier (30 sec, 2 charges), the second with the remaining charge or Alter Time (55 sec with Master of Time), and press Ice Block (Ice Cold, 70% damage reduction for 6 sec) if you are low.

[해제] Remove the Bound by Shadow (Magic shield; the Minion dies when it is removed) on the Minion of Zul along the way with Spellsteal (Wowhead). Since 12.1 the stolen shield no longer transfers to you.
2: [차단] Kick Risen Hexer's Hex Volley (3.5 sec cast, 116379 Shadow followed by a 12 sec curse DoT) with Counterspell (20 sec with Quick Witted). If it goes through and the curse lands, clear it with Remove Curse (8 sec), starting with the lowest-health player.

[광역 피해] The corner pack is a cooldown pull (Topicx). Throw Frozen Orb into the middle of the pack and put Ray of Frost on the Shadow-Borne Champion, but do not use Ray of Frost or Glacial Spike on the Champion during Vigilant Defense (6 sec channel), because it deflects ranged spells. Take Shadow Whirlwind with a recharged Ice Barrier charge, or Ice Block (Ice Cold) if no charge is left.
4: [광역 피해] Hold Frozen Orb and Ray of Frost until the tank has aggro on the pack that wakes up (Topicx). Spend them on the hardest pack, King A'akul with the Bloodsworn Assassins (Frostfire build follows with Comet Storm), and reapply Ice Barrier for the 10% Physical damage reduction if you are about to take Blood Drain (164870 Physical) while bleeding from Sudden Rupture.

[차단] Kick Queen Wasi's Bind Soul (2.5 sec cast, 10 sec charm) with Counterspell, and if Soul Bolt or Seneschal M'bara's Unholy Mending overlaps, stop it with Dragon's Breath (40 sec with Time Manipulation, 4 sec disorient) from within 12 yd. Remove Guard Captain Atu's Captain's Bulwark (30% less damage taken) with Spellsteal (Wowhead).

[회피] If King Timalji's Bladestorm (164870 Physical every 0.5 sec) chases you, Shimmer (27 sec with Flow of Time, 2 charges) away while you keep casting. Shimmer sideways out of Skeletal Hunting Raptor's Hunting Leap frontal attacks as well.
5: [광역 피해] Purification Construct's Purifying Flame (174568 Fire to everyone) hurts a lot, so apply Ice Barrier beforehand and press Ice Block (Ice Cold) if it overlaps and you are low. If your group lusts here on a high key (Topicx), press Time Warp and put Ray of Frost on the Construct.
[위치] When backing out of the zones on the bridge, move with Shimmer so you do not stop casting. Lay Frozen Orb and Blizzard on the nine Embalming Fluids dragged in.
6: [차단] The two Half-Finished Mummies' Wretched Discharge (4 sec cast, 12 sec Disease DoT on everyone) needs two kicks (Topicx). Take one with Counterspell and stop the other with Dragon's Breath from within 12 yd.
[광역 피해] While a player is trapped by Entomb, Wail of Mourning (77586 Shadow to everyone every 2 sec, growing) keeps ticking, so reapply Ice Barrier.
7: [차단] As in pull 6, stop one Half-Finished Mummy's Wretched Discharge with Counterspell and the other with Dragon's Breath. If Dragon's Breath (40 sec) is not back yet, tell the other kickers in advance.
[광역 피해] Lay Frozen Orb and Blizzard once the eight Embalming Fluids are stacked.
9: [우선 처치] Pour Glacial Spike and Ray of Frost into the two Spectral Shamans and kill them before more Healing Tide Totems come out (Topicx). Throw Frozen Orb toward the Shamans.
[차단] The two Phantom Hex Priests cast nonstop (Topicx), so kick one's Hex (3.5 sec cast, 5 sec transform) with Counterspell and stop the other with Dragon's Breath from within 12 yd.

[해제] A Hex that goes through is a Curse, so clear it at once with Remove Curse (8 sec) (Wowhead). If Royal Berserker's Bloodthirsty Axe bleed (29095 Physical every sec for 12 sec) lands on you, reapply Ice Barrier for the 10% Physical damage reduction.
10: [광역 피해] On a four-lust route, the third Bloodlust goes out on this pull (Topicx). If you are the group's lust, press Time Warp and put Ray of Frost on the Ghostly Brute.
[해제] Kick Phantom Hex Priest's Hex with Counterspell, and clear any Hex that goes through at once with Remove Curse (Wowhead).
12: [위치] Shadow Barrage goes to whoever engages first (Topicx), so do not open with Glacial Spike or Frostbolt before the tank is on it. If you take the far Pool of Darkness, Shimmer into it while you keep casting.
[광역 피해] If targeted by Dark Revelation (473120 Shadow within 20 yd after 5 sec), Shimmer more than 20 yd away from the group and reapply Ice Barrier. Press Ice Block (Ice Cold) if you are low.
[해제] When a Minion of Zul appears after Dark Revelation (Method), remove its Bound by Shadow with Spellsteal to kill it at once (Wowhead).

1: [차단] The two Flashfrost Chillweavers' Ice Shield (15 sec channel, a shield and crowd control immunity every 3 sec) must be kicked. Take one of them with Counterspell (20 sec with Quick Witted).

[제어] If the four Deepstone Earthshapers' Tectonic Strike stacks get high, step within 12 yd of the Earthshapers stacked on the tank and freeze them with Frost Nova (25 sec with Time Manipulation, 6 sec freeze) so the tank can walk away and drop the stacks (Topicx: stun them and step away). Neither Frost M+ build has a stun, and Primal Juggernaut is immune to crowd control.

[광역 피해] This is a big pull gathered up to the entrance corridor. Throw Frozen Orb (1 min) once everything is stacked and put Ray of Frost (1 min) on the Primal Juggernaut (Frostfire build follows with Comet Storm). Reapply Ice Barrier (30 sec, 2 charges) for Excavating Blast (106681 Nature to everyone plus an 8 sec DoT).
2: [차단] Kick Flashfrost Chillweaver's Ice Shield with Counterspell.
[우선 처치] Pour Ray of Frost and Glacial Spike into the crowd-control-immune Primal Juggernaut and kill it first.
3: [광역 피해] Defier Draghar's Steel Barrage hits six times over 3 sec and each strike deals 24246 Fire to everyone within 60 yd, so keep Ice Barrier up.

[우선 처치] Put Ray of Frost on the crowd-control-immune Draghar (Frostfire build follows with Comet Storm), and kick Flashfrost Chillweaver's Ice Shield with Counterspell. Freeze the two Earthshapers with Frost Nova if their stacks get high.
5: [차단] Spend Counterspell on the two Primalist Cinderweavers' Cinderbolt (2.5 sec cast, 116379 Fire) first (Topicx). Ashseer Flamelasher's Flaming Barrage (10 sec channel) cannot be interrupted, so stop it with Dragon's Breath (40 sec with Time Manipulation, 4 sec disorient) from within 12 yd.
[해제] Remove the Blaze of Glory (15 sec channel, 290947 Fire embers every 3 sec) that a Flamelasher starts as it dies with Spellsteal (Wowhead).

[광역 피해] Reapply Ice Barrier for Blazebound Destroyer's Inferno party Fire damage, and Shimmer (27 sec with Flow of Time, 2 charges) out at once when the dying Destroyer casts Burnout (20 yd explosion). If targeted by Living Bomb, Shimmer away from the group as well.
6: [광역 피해] Below 50%, Flamegullet's Molten Blood (Fire within 60 yd every 3 sec, 15% more per cast) keeps raising party damage. On +17 and above Bloodlust goes out at 50% (Topicx), so if you are the group's lust, press Time Warp (5 min) and put Ray of Frost on Flamegullet.

[회피] If targeted by Flame Breath (4 sec cast, 96982 Fire in a frontal cone every 0.5 sec), Shimmer sideways. If Molten Blood stacks up and you are low, follow Ice Barrier with Ice Block (Ice Cold, 70% damage reduction for 6 sec).
[차단] Stop Cinderweaver's Cinderbolt with Counterspell and Flamelasher's Flaming Barrage with Dragon's Breath, and remove Blaze of Glory with Spellsteal when the Flamelasher dies (Wowhead).
7: [차단] Stop the two Cinderweavers' Cinderbolt with Counterspell and Ashseer Flamelasher's Flaming Barrage with Dragon's Breath. If the channel keeps going, the group dies (Topicx).
[해제] Remove Blaze of Glory with Spellsteal each time one of the two Flamelashers dies (Wowhead). Spellsteal has no cooldown but costs 21% of base mana.
[광역 피해] Throw Frozen Orb once the pack is stacked, and Shimmer more than 20 yd away when the dying Destroyer casts Burnout.
8: [차단] Same pack as pull 7. Stop Cinderbolt with Counterspell and Flaming Barrage with Dragon's Breath, and remove the dying Flamelasher's Blaze of Glory with Spellsteal (Wowhead).
[위치] Thunderhead patrols near this pack (Topicx). Frozen Orb travels forward and hits every enemy it passes, so do not throw it toward Thunderhead.
10: [회피] If targeted by Tempest Channeler's Lightning Torrent (7 sec channel, 65463 Nature every sec), reapply Ice Barrier and press Ice Block (Ice Cold) if you are low. Wowhead says the same channel from Ryvati can be cancelled with Greater Invisibility (1 min with Master of Escape).
[광역 피해] Lay Frozen Orb and Blizzard once the six Storm Warriors are stacked. Stop Ashseer Flamelasher's Flaming Barrage with Dragon's Breath and remove Blaze of Glory with Spellsteal (Wowhead).
[차단] Kick the crowd-control-immune Tempest Channeler's Thunder Blast (4 sec cast, 387930 Nature on the tank) when Counterspell is free.
11: [차단] Kick Primalist Cinderweaver's Cinderbolt with Counterspell first, and kick Tempest Channeler's Thunder Blast if it is free.
[회피] If targeted by Lightning Torrent, reapply Ice Barrier and press Ice Block (Ice Cold) if you are low. If targeted by Living Bomb, Shimmer more than 6 yd away from the group.
12: [광역 피해] If Ryvati's Tempest Stormshield (absorbs 20% of max health, 29095 Nature to everyone every sec while up) expires unbroken, everyone within 60 yd is stunned for 4 sec. Break it quickly with Ray of Frost and Glacial Spike (Frostfire build follows with Comet Storm). If your group lusts on Ryvati on high keys (Topicx), press Time Warp here.
[회피] If Ryvati channels Lightning Torrent on you, you can cancel it with Greater Invisibility (Wowhead). If Greater Invisibility is down, reapply Ice Barrier and take it.
[해제] Remove the Stormcloud Barrier (shield worth 85% of max health) on Primal Thunderclouds with Spellsteal (Wowhead). When removed, the Thundercloud explodes with Stormcloud Detonation (tooltip).

1: [우선 처치] Kill the crowd-control-immune Sandfury Stonefist first (Topicx). Pour Ray of Frost (1 min) and Glacial Spike into the Stonefist (Frostfire build follows with Comet Storm), and throw Frozen Orb (1 min) after the tank has gathered the pack at the corner.

[광역 피해] When you see the Ground Pound cast (4 sec cast, 156627 Physical within 60 yd plus a knockback), reapply Ice Barrier (30 sec, 2 charges). Improved Ice Barrier cuts your Physical damage taken by 10%. If Storm Adept's Lightning Bolt lands on top of it, people die (Topicx), so time Counterspell (20 sec with Quick Witted) for that moment.

[회피] If Sandswept Hunter fires Arrow Barrage at you (9 sec channel, 43642 Physical every 0.8 sec), you can cancel it with Greater Invisibility (1 min with Master of Escape) (Wowhead). Clear Shrouded Fang's Slither Strike by reapplying Ice Barrier with Energized Barriers (Wowhead).
2: [차단] Take one of the two Storm Adepts' Lightning Bolt (2.5 sec cast, 116379 Nature) with Counterspell, and stop Sandswept Hunter's Arrow Barrage with Dragon's Breath (40 sec with Time Manipulation, 4 sec disorient) if you are within 12 yd.

[광역 피해] Reapply Ice Barrier for Ground Pound, and press Ice Block (Ice Cold, 70% damage reduction for 6 sec) if Barbed Krolusk's Serrated Charge bleed (38793 Physical every sec for 6 sec) overlaps and you are low.
4: [우선 처치] If Sand-Sworn Rider lives long, its Swarming Krolusks add rush the far-away DPS (Topicx). Kill the Rider first with Ray of Frost and Glacial Spike.

[제어] If the Swarming Krolusks rush you, freeze them with Frost Nova (25 sec with Time Manipulation, 6 sec freeze) and Shimmer (27 sec with Flow of Time, 2 charges) back toward the tank. The Rider's Scouring Sand (4.5 sec cast, 290947 Nature in a frontal cone plus a 4 sec disorient) covers the bridge about 5 sec after the pull (Topicx), so stand out of the front.
[차단] Kick Storm Adept's Lightning Bolt with Counterspell. If Sandswept Hunter fires Arrow Barrage at you, you can cancel it with Greater Invisibility (Wowhead).
5: [차단] If the two Storm Adepts' Lightning Bolt lands on someone hit by a Krolusk leap or Cytotoxin, that player dies (Topicx). Take one with Counterspell and stop the other with Dragon's Breath next to the tank.
[광역 피해] This is a big pull. Throw Frozen Orb once the pack is stacked before the Rider comes in, and put Ray of Frost on the Rider when it joins (Frostfire build follows with Comet Storm).

[제어] If the Swarming Krolusks summoned by Dutiful Tamer and the Rider rush you, freeze them with Frost Nova, and if a Serrated Charge bleed hits you, reapply Ice Barrier for the 10% Physical damage reduction.
6: [차단] One player is enough for Faithless Subjugator's Addle Mind (5 sec cast, 5 sec disorient) (Topicx). Take it with Counterspell, and if it goes through, it is a Curse, so clear it with Remove Curse (8 sec).
[제어] If the Swarming Krolusks rush you, freeze them with Frost Nova, and put Ray of Frost on the Sand-Sworn Rider.
7: [차단] Take Faithless Subjugator's Addle Mind with Counterspell and clear it with Remove Curse if it lands. Stop Brood Tender's Venom Bolt with Dragon's Breath so it does not land on top of Cytotoxin poison (Topicx).
[회피] If Sandswept Hunter fires Arrow Barrage at you, you can cancel it with Greater Invisibility (Wowhead). Put Ray of Frost on the Sand-Sworn Rider.
9: [해제] Remove the two Agitated Nimbuses' Accumulate Charge (8% more damage, up to 3 stacks, Magic) with Spellsteal (Wowhead). Release Charge unleashes the energy built up by Accumulate Charge (tooltip).

[광역 피해] Reapply Ice Barrier for Release Charge (3 sec cast, 145474 Nature to everyone), and press Ice Block (Ice Cold) if both Nimbuses' Release Charge overlap. Kick Imbued Stormcaller's Lightning Bolt with Counterspell while it goes off (Topicx: do not let kicks slip).
10: [차단] Lock down the two Imbued Stormcallers before gathering the other mobs (Topicx). Take one with Counterspell and the other with Dragon's Breath.

[해제] Remove Agitated Nimbus's Accumulate Charge with Spellsteal (Wowhead), reapply Ice Barrier for Release Charge, and press Ice Block (Ice Cold) if you are low. Lay Frozen Orb and Blizzard on the four Static Anomalies.
12: [제어] Temple Disruptor can be interrupted with Polymorph (Wowhead). Lock the Disruptor on the far side with Polymorph (1.7 sec cast, 1 min), and do not use Frozen Orb or Blizzard toward it, because damage breaks the sheep.

[차단] Kick the near Disruptor's Essence Disruption channel with Counterspell to protect the orb's charge. Throw Frozen Orb on the gathered Faithless Conscripts and Orb Watcher, and put Ray of Frost on the Orb Watcher.
[광역 피해] Reapply Ice Barrier for Orb Watcher's Caustic Stomp (3.5 sec cast, 116379 Nature within 60 yd plus a 10 sec DoT).
13: [제어] As in pull 12, lock the far Temple Disruptor with Polymorph (Wowhead) and kick the near Disruptor with Counterspell. Once the orb reaches 100% the Disruptors stop casting (Topicx), so use Frozen Orb and Ray of Frost on what is left.
[광역 피해] Reapply Ice Barrier for Caustic Stomp.
14: [차단] The crowd-control-immune Twisted Hexxer's Flame Shock (4 sec cast, 242456 Fire plus an 8 sec DoT) must be kicked, so save Counterspell for it.

[제어] When the four Faithless Tormentors chase the healer (Topicx), freeze them with Frost Nova or slow them with Cone of Cold (25 sec, 50% slow for 8 sec), and keep them slowed with Frozen Orb and Blizzard.
[회피] If targeted by Latent Hex, Shimmer out of the group so the Hex Muck does not form under the group.
